calfresh_case_last_digit.summary: CalFresh benefits are made available over the first 10 days of every month, based on the last digit of the county case number.
notes: Use only the last digit of your CalFresh case number — never enter the full case number on this site.
Some county cash-aid programs (e.g. CalWORKs) use different schedules; this tool covers recurring CalFresh food benefits.
Los Angeles County follows the same last-digit pattern for CalFresh in the USDA FNS statewide table; always confirm with your county notice if unsure.
